title: Diamond Elite Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains credit card APY bonuses for Diamond Elite Account holders, which are automatically applied when you hold an eligible Rho-Bank credit card under the same customer profile. Bonus rates listed include Platinum Rewards Card +0.1%, Diamond Elite Card +0.5%, and Crypto-Cash Back Card +0.15% (others shown as +0%).
